Hi all — copied in for POA/legal acceptance. Short checklist from Legal: 

1) POA acceptance: we will accept a POA for execution of the Order Form only if:
   - POA is notarized (or otherwise executed per local law),
   - POA explicitly references authority to bind the company on commercial contracts and names the document types (Order Form / MSA), and
   - POA is attached to the executed PDF and retained in our contract repository.

2) Signer names: we need the full name and title of the POA signatory to populate the DocuSign identity fields.

3) Redlines: I reviewed the MSA redline quickly — a couple of low-risk edits we can accept; please highlight any sections Helix absolutely needs (we'll mark as exceptions).

4) Clean copy: once the envelope is executed, Sales Ops should provide a single concatenated PDF (MSA + Order Form + POA if used) and route final to Contract Repository and to both parties.

Laura — can you add the POA checklist and final artifact naming convention to the envelope description (we use: HELIX_EXECUTED_YYYYMMDD.pdf)?
